map.以下工具与本页面常一起使用：: Tools commonly used with this page:

map.并发加载各站点的 favicon 图片，以 onload / onerror /: Loads each site favicon in parallel and judges reachability via onload / onerror / timeout with approximate latency, max 5 concurrent. Image probing bypasses CORS but only checks network-layer reachability.
map.尚未有运行记录，点击上方「开始探测」开始。: No run history yet. Click "Start probe" above to start.

map.为什么有的站点总是不可达？: Why is a site always unreachable?
